The Memsic 2125 straddles the centre gap in columns 17-19. Top half, left to right: GND.1 (col 17), YOUT (col 18), TOUT/Temp (col 19). Bottom half, left to right: GND.2 (col 17), XOUT (col 18), VDD (col 19). This follows the circuit image, where the black, blue and orange wires land on those columns.
The exact breadboard columns and rows are read from the image and are approximate. Each wire shares a strip with the sensor pin it serves.

The long black wire goes from the Uno GND to the breadboard's bottom ground rail (bn). Two short black wires then take ground from that rail to the sensor's two GND pins. The rail holes bn.10, bn.12 and bn.16 are approximate, and any hole in the rail is the same strip.
Wire colours: orange is 5V to VDD, yellow is pin 2 to X out, blue is pin 3 to Y out.
The Temp (TOUT) pin is left unconnected, as in the image and schematic. The 5V pin goes only to the sensor's VDD, and the sensor is a 5V part.
